entries.templateText: Oi, look what the Thames washed into {DISTRICT}! Keep yer mince pies on 'em!
Blimey! A tea leaf pinching brass right in {DISTRICT}!
Up an' at 'em, lads! Don't let {FACTION} catch us napping!
*hack* *cough* Proper pea-souper today... lungs full o' anthracite!
Gawd blimey, she's spitting steam at {PRESSURE} kPa! Watch yer bacon!
'Ere now! This is {FACTION} manor! Hook it, mate, or get a clobbering!
Roll up, guv'nor! Finest gear in {DISTRICT}, honest shilling's worth!
Another grueling {SHIFT} turn under the smokestacks.
Remarkable! An anomalous specimen sighted within {DISTRICT}.
Preposterous! Gross violation of municipal statutes observed in {DISTRICT}!
Colleagues of {FACTION}, advance in strict formation! Secure the perimeter!
The atmospheric coal particulate concentration exceeds acceptable physiological margins!
Pneumatic pressure release logged at {PRESSURE} kPa. Thermodynamic equilibrium restoring.
You have breached the restricted experimental domain of {FACTION}.
Greetings, scholar. I offer calibrated scientific apparatus and refined reagents.
Conducting empirical observations during the {SHIFT} phase.
Mark the cove skulking through {DISTRICT}.
Nip the rogue! Lifting {FACTION} swag in broad daylight!
Syndicate, draw iron! Rattle their clockwork!
Thick black fog... good for the sneak, bad for the bellows.
Boiler hissed at {PRESSURE} kPa! Scuttle before the blast!
Yer on {FACTION} cobbles now, pigeon. Cough up the drop or bleed.
Quiet goods for clever hands. No questions asked in {DISTRICT}.
Shadows stretch long on the {SHIFT}. The Underworld never sleeps.
Halt in the Queen's name! Identify yourself in {DISTRICT}!
Felonious breach detected! You are under arrest for crimes against {FACTION}!
Constabulary patrol, assemble on my mark! Subdue the belligerent!
Heavy smog advisory in effect. Visual range compromised.
Industrial safety hazard: high pressure recorded at {PRESSURE} kPa.
Curfew and perimeter restrictions strictly enforced by order of {FACTION}.
Licensed municipal supplies available for authorized personnel.
Municipal patrol ongoing throughout the {SHIFT} watch.
